text:
Ravi: 2am thought: what's everyone's 10-minute unwind combo? a tiny story + one track. Need fresh rotation.
June: Love this. I do a 5-min flash + a single Lo-fi hiphop beat. Right now: 'A Small Silence' (flash) + 'lofi rain mix' on YouTube.
Harper: For me it's cosy crime microfiction + something folky. E.g., 'The Coin Toss' + Sufjan Stevens - 'Mystery of Love' (soft).
Sasha: I prefer surreal tiny poems + synthwave to feel cinematic. "The Clockshop" (micropoem) + 'FM-84 - Running in the Night'.
Ravi: @June drop that YouTube link?
June: https://youtu.be/lofimixexample (just typed a placeholder but same idea) :grin:
Jukebox-Bot: Quick playlist made: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/2175-unwind-rotations  added FM-84, Sufjan, lo-fi mixes.
Harper: Tiny read recs: Lydia Davis shorts, "Please Come Back" (two-paragraph flash), and 'The Coin Toss' from that indie zine.
Sasha: Poll: react with :one: for 'cozy/folk', :two: for 'lofi/ambient', :three: for 'synth/cinematic'. I'll tally midday.
Ravi: Posting my micro list: ```- Lydia Davis - assorted flashes
- Junji Ito - small weirds (for nights you want weird)
- Elena Ferrante - short fragment
``` + tracks: FM-84, Sufjan, Nina Simone - 'Feeling Good' (for dramatic exits)
June: Nina Simone + microfiction is a vibe. Also tiny PSA: set phone to Do Not Disturb or you'll lose the 10 minutes to pings.
Harper: Also if anyone wants, I can export the playlist into a collaborative thing. Good for shared breaks.
Jukebox-Bot: Collaborative playlist enabled by Harper.
Sasha: Can we pin this thread in #random as '10-min unwind kit'?
Ravi: Pin please. Might actually save sobriety levels around 4pm. :laughing:
